Subject: Renewal: Geo scope update & APAC hot-standby commitment

Hi Alice —

Hope youre well. Your renewal is coming up on July 31; following our pilot success, we wanted to put a proposal on the table that matches the next phase of MediCores needs. Key points in the attached renewal_proposal_v1.pdf: 

- Primary EU residency for all EU traffic (data at rest and processing in EU region)
- APAC hot-standby with automated failover and burst capacity up to 150% for up to 90 days per year
- Committed monthly units (3-year term preferred) with a committed discount and top-up credits for bursts

If those align with what youre expecting, happy to schedule a short sync to walk the SOW and pricing. If you have a formal list of requirements, please share and well update the SOW.

Thanks,

Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal: Geo scope update & APAC hot-standby commitment

Ben —

Thanks for the proposal and timeline. A few clarifications from our side before we escalate to procurement: 

1) EU residency: This must be the primary processing region for EU patients; we need contractual language on data residency, KMS controls, and audit access.
2) APAC hot-standby: We need the hot-standby node to be available for failover (automated routing) and to support up to 150% sustained token consumption for short surge windows. Please include runbook-level SLAs for failover and RTO/RPO targets.
3) Term & pricing: Were open to a multi-year commitment if the pricing is predictable and includes capacity top-ups. Procurement will want a clear committed vs burst pricing table.
4) Compliance evidence: SOC 2 report, encryption/TLS attestations, and a diagram of where logs are stored are required for our audit team.

I attached our internal renewal_requirements doc for reference. Procurement will follow with a formal SOW and redlines. 

Would you be available for a 30-minute call next week (Wed or Thurs) to align on the mutual action plan?

Best,
Alice Jensen
VP, Platform Operations | MediCore Health
alice.jensen@medicore.com

Attachment: MediCore_renewal_req.docx (DOCX, 78 KB)

Folks — forwarding Alices asks from MediCore. High level thoughts below; need quick alignment so we can give procurement a first-pass SOW + pricing by Monday.

Quoted: 
> EU residency: primary processing in EU, contractual KMS controls, audit access
> APAC hot-standby: automated failover + 150% burst for short windows
> Term & pricing: committed vs burst table needed
> Compliance evidence: SOC2 + logs diagram

My proposal: 
- Offer a 36-month committed term with a 20% committed discount, separate burst pricing (per-token) above committed baseline.
- Charge a hot-standby premium (monthly flat) to reserve capacity and cover the autoscale runbook.
- Include SOC2 snapshot and a security appendix; Karthik can confirm what we can ship immediately.

Can Karthik confirm approximate cost delta for hot-standby + 150% burst and lead time for APAC node? Monica — legal will need to see the SOW redline; I expect procurement will send that later today.

Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:32:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: Geo scope update & APAC hot-standby commitment

Ben / Neha —

Technical run-down (high level):

Options for EU residency:
- Option A: EU primary tenancy (recommended) — data at rest + processing in EU region. Lead time ~4 weeks if we reuse existing EU node.
- Option B: Dual-write with EU mirror (more complex, not recommended for now).

APAC hot-standby options:
- Warm-standby: standby instance with cold cache. Lower cost, longer failover (RTO ~10-30 min).
- Hot-standby: active node with warmed KV caches and automated routing; RTO < 2 min. Higher monthly fee. Supports burst to 150% if we provision autoscaling headroom and pre-warm caches. Lead time ~6-8 weeks for fully provisioned hot-standby plus runbook tests.

Estimated delta to price (ballpark):
- Hot-standby premium: +18-25% of baseline committed cost per month (depends on instance sizes).
- Burst top-up pricing: per-token rate ~1.6x published committed rate during surge windows.

I attached an options spreadsheet with capacity scenarios and rough pricing tiers. If procurement wants firm numbers we should convert the preferred option into an SOW and a one-page runbook appendix.

Attachment: apac_hotstandby_options.xlsx (XLSX, 92 KB)

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
